in_hebrew.name: פרידער
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'prd' which means 'peaceful' and 'rdh' which means 'leader' or 'ruler'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but the meaning of peace and leadership can be seen in many biblical names such as 'Simeon' (שמעון) which means 'he who hears' or 'listens', and 'Reuben' (רובן) which means 'behold, a son'. The name Frieder can be seen as a modern, Germanic interpretation of these biblical names and their meanings.

in_greek.name: Φρίδερος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'εἰρήνη' (eirēnē) which means 'peace' and the suffix 'δης' (-dēs) which means 'one'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it can be seen as a translation of biblical names with similar meanings such as 'Saul' (Σαούλ) which means 'asked for' or 'desired' and 'peaceful' and 'David' (Δαυιδ) which means 'beloved' and 'fighter of God' but also 'beloved' and 'peace'. The name Frieder can be seen as a modern, Greek interpretation of these biblical names and their meanings.

in_latin.name: Frieder
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'pax' which means 'peace' and the suffix '-er' which means 'one'. This name is not directly found in the Bible, but it can be seen as a translation of biblical names with similar meanings such as 'Paul' (Paulus) which means 'small' or 'humble' and 'peaceful' and 'Peter' (Petrus) which means 'rock' and 'peaceful'. The name Frieder can be seen as a modern, Latin interpretation of these biblical names and their meanings.
